title: Calendar heatmap
description: Daily values on a calendar, like contribution graphs: commits, learning streaks, workouts, orders. Each day is a cell colored by level; month and weekday names, tooltip dates and the first day of the week follow the locale. The legend hides / shows levels; the arrow keys move by day and by week, and the tooltip shows the date.

props.name: animation
props.description: Entry and update animations, skipped when the user prefers reduced motion (default `true`)

props.name: deep
props.description:
Also follows in-place mutations of nested data (`series[0].data.push()`);
by default the chart updates when a prop is replaced (cheaper on large data)

props.name: legend
props.description: Legend; clicking an item hides / shows its slice, stage or series (shown by default for pie, donut, funnel and multi-series radar charts)

props.name: tooltip
props.description: Tooltip; `false` disables it (default `true`)

props.name: monthLabels
props.description: Month names (and years) around the cells (default `true`)

props.name: weekdayLabels
props.description: Weekday names beside (weeks) or above (months) the cells (default `true`)

props.name: color
props.description: Color of the highest level (lower levels are lighter; default: the first palette color)

props.name: layout
props.description: `weeks`: a column per week and a row per weekday; `months`: a small calendar per month (default `weeks`)

props.name: renderer
props.description: Backend of the shapes: `auto` tries WebGPU, then WebGL2, then WebGL, then Canvas2D, skipping GPUs running in software; text is always drawn with Canvas2D (default `auto`, see `setDefaultChartRenderer`)

props.name: width
props.description: Width of the chart; numbers are pixels (default `100%`)

props.name: height
props.description: Height of the chart (the legend included); numbers are pixels, strings any CSS length

props.name: padding
props.description: Space around the drawing, in pixels (default 8 on every side)

props.name: palette
props.description: Colors of the marks without `color` (defaults to the `--chart-series-1..8` CSS variables, then the theme colors)

props.name: ariaLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the chart (default: the chart type, e.g. "Donut chart")

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale of the texts and numbers the engine writes (tooltip rows, accessible names, compact numbers); the page language by default

props.name: range
props.description: Days shown: a year (`2026`) or an inclusive `[start, end]` range (default: the 53 weeks ending on the last day of the data)

props.name: hidden
props.description:
Hidden slices / stages / radar series / top-level treemap nodes, by
index. Makes the visibility controlled: legend clicks then only emit
`toggle`, whose `hiddenIndexes` should be stored and passed back.

props.name: texts
props.description: Replaces built-in texts of the `locale` (tooltip rows, accessible names, "No data")

props.name: data
props.description: Daily values (several entries of the same day add up)

props.name: format
props.description: Formats the values of the labels and the tooltip (default: compact numbers, 1.2k, 3.4M)

props.name: percentFormat
props.description: Formats the shares (labels, conversion rates, tooltip); `share` is 0-1 (default: one decimal, "40.0%")

props.name: weekStart
props.description: First day of the week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday (default: from `locale`)

props.name: levels
props.description: Number of color levels above the empty days (default 4)

props.name: gap
props.description: Gap between the cells, in pixels (default 3)

props.name: radius
props.description: Corner radius of the cells, in pixels (default 2)

props.name: maxCellSize
props.description: Largest cell size, in pixels (default 16 weeks, 28 months)

props.name: colors
props.description: Colors of the levels, lowest first (replaces `color` and sets the number of levels)

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Upper bounds of the levels but the last, ascending; an even split of the largest value by default

<script setup lang="ts">
// A year of daily values, contributions-style: the month and weekday names
// and the first day of the week follow `locale` (the page language here).
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { CalendarHeatmap } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { locale: "en-US", unit: "contributions" },
  zh: { locale: "zh-CN", unit: "次贡献" },
  ja: { locale: "ja-JP", unit: "件のコントリビューション" },
  fr: { locale: "fr-FR", unit: "contributions" },
};

// one value per day of 2025: busier on weekdays, deterministic
const fraction = (value: number) => value - Math.floor(value);
const DAYS = Array.from({ length: 365 }, (_, i) => ({
  date: Date.UTC(2025, 0, 1 + i),
  value: Math.floor(
    fraction(Math.sin(i * 12.9898) * 43758.5453) * (i % 7 < 5 ? 9 : 3),
  ),
}));

const { language } = useI18n();
const text = computed(() => TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en);
const format = (value: number) => `${value} ${text.value.unit}`;
</script>

<template>
  <CalendarHeatmap
    :data="DAYS"
    :range="2025"
    :locale="text.locale"
    :format="format"
  />
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
// `layout="months"`: a small calendar per month; `levels` sets the number
// of color steps above the empty days, `thresholds` their bounds.
import { computed } from "vue";
import { useI18n } from "minerva-design/vue";
import { CalendarHeatmap } from "minerva-design/vue/charts";

const TEXT = {
  en: { locale: "en-US" },
  zh: { locale: "zh-CN" },
  ja: { locale: "ja-JP" },
  fr: { locale: "fr-FR" },
};

// steps walked every day of the first half of 2026, deterministic
const fraction = (value: number) => value - Math.floor(value);
const STEPS = Array.from({ length: 181 }, (_, i) => ({
  date: Date.UTC(2026, 0, 1 + i),
  value: Math.round(3000 + fraction(Math.sin(i * 78.233) * 43758.5453) * 9000),
}));

const { language } = useI18n();
const locale = computed(() => (TEXT[language.value] ?? TEXT.en).locale);
</script>

<template>
  <CalendarHeatmap
    :data="STEPS"
    :range="['2026-01-01', '2026-06-30']"
    layout="months"
    :levels="5"
    :thresholds="[4000, 6000, 8000, 10000]"
    color="var(--success-color, #16a34a)"
    :locale="locale"
    :height="420"
  />
</template>

translationResources.title: Calendar heatmap
translationResources.description: Daily values on a calendar, like contribution graphs: commits, learning streaks, workouts, orders. Each day is a cell colored by level; month and weekday names, tooltip dates and the first day of the week follow the locale. The legend hides / shows levels; the arrow keys move by day and by week, and the tooltip shows the date.

contributions.title: Contributions over a year
contributions.description: Without range, the chart shows the 53 weeks ending on the last day of the data. color sets the highest level (lower levels are lighter, in light and dark themes); onClick reports the day, with its formatted date in name and its YYYY-MM-DD date in date.

streak.title: Learning streak
streak.description: range={2026} shows the whole year, future days included. thresholds sets the bounds of the levels (1–15, 16–30, 31–60 and more than 60 minutes) and format their names; the streaks are computed from the same data.

multi-year.title: Several years
multi-year.description: A range longer than a year is drawn as one strip per year, with the year beside it; the height grows with the number of strips.

months.title: Month calendars
months.description: layout="months" draws a small calendar per month, in the grid that gives the biggest cells. weekStart overrides the first day of the week given by the locale; days without orders (closed on Mondays) stay empty.

locale.title: Locales
locale.description: locale translates the month and weekday names and the tooltip dates, and gives the first day of the week (Sunday in the United States and Japan, Monday in France and Germany, Saturday in Egypt). maxCellSize keeps the cells small on wide screens.

energy.title: Filtering levels
energy.description: Daily electricity use with four custom colors and thresholds. hidden makes the legend controlled: onToggle returns the hiddenIndexes to store, so the buttons can hide levels too, and the readout adds up the days still shown.

sleep.title: Custom tooltip
sleep.description: Six months of sleep in a [start, end] range. renderTooltip receives the formatted date in name and the hours in value, and compares them with the eight-hour goal; nights without data get their own message.

incidents.title: Year picker and hover
incidents.description: One dataset of production incidents over three years: the RadioGroup only changes range, which picks the year drawn. onHover reports the hovered day below the chart (null when the pointer leaves), with a message for the days still to come.

habit-toggle.title: Click to log a day
habit-toggle.description: A workout log in layout="months" with a single level (levels={1}): onClick gives the date of the clicked day, which is added to or removed from the state that feeds data. The streak and the readout follow.

basic.title: Basic
basic.description: Commits per day over the last four months, a range that fits a phone; month and weekday names follow the app language, a tap selects a day.

data.total: {{total}} commits in the last four months
data.tapDay: Tap a day to select it

CalendarHeatmapProps.data: Daily values: a date (YYYY-MM-DD string, Date or timestamp) and a value; values of the same day add up
CalendarHeatmapProps.range: Days shown: a year (2026) or an inclusive [start, end] range; the 53 weeks ending on the last day of the data by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.layout: weeks: a column per week and a row per weekday (a strip per year for long ranges); months: a small calendar per month
CalendarHeatmapProps.weekStart: First day of the week, 0 = Sunday … 6 = Saturday; taken from locale by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.locale: BCP 47 locale of the month and weekday names, of the tooltip dates, of the default weekStart and of the built-in texts; defaults to the page language (`<html lang>`)
CalendarHeatmapProps.color: Color of the highest level (lower levels are lighter); the first palette color by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.colors: Colors of the levels, lowest first (replaces color and sets the number of levels)
CalendarHeatmapProps.levels: Number of color levels above the empty days
CalendarHeatmapProps.thresholds: Upper bounds of the levels but the last, ascending ([2, 5, 10]: 1–2, 3–5, 6–10, more); an even split of the largest value by default
CalendarHeatmapProps.gap: Gap between the cells, in pixels
CalendarHeatmapProps.radius: Corner radius of the cells, in pixels
CalendarHeatmapProps.maxCellSize: Largest cell size, in pixels (cells shrink to fit the width)
CalendarHeatmapProps.monthLabels: Shows the month names (and the years)
CalendarHeatmapProps.weekdayLabels: Shows the weekday names beside (weeks) or above (months) the cells

CalendarDatum.date: Day of the value: a YYYY-MM-DD string, a Date or a timestamp (local calendar day)
CalendarDatum.value: Value of the day (negative values count as 0)

props.height: Height of the chart, the legend included: pixels or any CSS length
props.options: Other engine options (axes, legend, tooltip, palette, format…) merged with the element's own properties; property only
props.instance: The engine instance (minerva-design/charts/core), null until the element is rendered and connected

events.minerva-hover: The hovered (or keyboard-focused) mark changed; detail: { index, name, value, share }, null when nothing is hovered
events.minerva-click: A mark was clicked, tapped or activated with Enter; detail: { index, name, value, share }
events.minerva-toggle: A legend item was clicked (or toggle() called); detail: { index, hidden, hiddenIndexes }

methods.toggle: Hides / shows a slice, stage, radar series or top-level treemap node by index
